title: TradeIndia B2B Supplier Scraper Input
description: Search TradeIndia public supplier and product listings. Defaults are set for a low-cost one-result LED light supplier test.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Product or service keywords to search on TradeIndia. Start with one keyword to keep usage low.

city.title: City filter
city.description: Optional exact city filter applied to parsed supplier records.

state.title: State filter
state.description: Optional exact state filter applied to parsed supplier records.

businessTypes.title: Business type filters
businessTypes.description: Optional filters such as Manufacturer, Supplier, Exporter, Distributor, Trader, or Service Provider.

trustedOnly.title: Trusted sellers only
trustedOnly.description: Keep only records marked as trusted by TradeIndia.

madeInIndiaOnly.title: Made in India only
madeInIndiaOnly.description: Keep only records marked as Made in India.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of unique supplier/product records to save. Start with 1 for a small test run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Leave disabled unless TradeIndia rate limits a run. Proxy traffic may be billed as platform usage.
